verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM runner, so loading quantized formats is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows GGUF import and a llama.cpp backend; it never mentions FP8, INT4, GPTQ or AWQ, or quantization levels at all. Treating GGUF as covering the named formats would require outside knowledge, so there is no documented support for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
